thread:
anne: Heads-up from FinOps pilot: they want model-level token cost and a way to link traces to error events for their chargeback reports. Asking if we can bundle into next observability push.

tom: Short answer: yes, but two paths. Quick path = sampled telemetry + dashboard. Full path = per-request billing pipeline, bigger work.

ravi: For tracing: we lack consistent trace_id across edge <-> runtime currently. I can add propagate header and log enrichment in a small change (~1 day).

anne: If we do sampled telemetry, what sampling rate gives mile-high accuracy?

ravi: 10% sampling should give good signal for breakdowns, +/- noise on tiny routes. We can make enterprise accounts opt into 100%.

ops-bot: ops-bot: queued cost-sim job id 12021 for 1.2M tokens/day @ 10% sampling, ETA 10m.

tom: Billing tags: we need to emit model_name and route_name from the runtime into metrics before aggregation. That's a small schema bump in the ingestion pipeline.

lina: Add quant_profile as well — customers want to compare quantized vs fp32 cost.

anne: Proposed minimal scope to ship as beta:
- Cost Explorer UI: 24h/7d/30d with per-model and per-route aggregates
- Opt-in header x-rw-trace-id propagated end-to-end, surfaced on error events
- Billing tags (model_name, route_name, quant_profile) in nightly aggregates

sam: Rollout plan: canary to 2 enterprise pilots, feature-flagged, docs + SDK example for header.

ravi: I'll implement header propagation and add unit tests. Need someone to own KV cache wiring.

tom: I'll take the billing pipeline change (schema bump + join) and coordinate with SRE for ingestion impact.

ops-bot: ops-bot: cost-sim job 12021 complete: estimated telemetry cost delta ~$210/month at 10% sampling.

lina: That cost seems fine for pilots. Remember to include data retention notes for EU customers.

anne: Acceptance criteria (for PM signoff):
1) Dashboard shows per-model breakdown for pilot accounts
2) Trace id appears on error payloads in logs for canary customers
3) Billing tags present in nightly aggregates for top routes

anne: Ok folks, assign owners in roadmap card and I'll update roadmap board. Thanks!

sam: Noted. I'll prepare canary checklist and legal/data contact template.

tom: Sending a short RFC for the ingestion schema change today.

ravi: Starting the runtime PR now.
